v: tri॰ aBi + saca--Rvi--KArTe Ric--kvip vA । 1 ABimuKyena sambanDuM samarTe 2 aBiBAvuke ca “vaso aBizAcafzvAn” f॰ 6, 63, 9 ।
a: अभिषाच् — a. [अभि-सच् स्वार्थे णिच् क्विप्] Ved. 1 Following. --2 Honouring, devoted. --3 Defeating.

v: tri॰ aBi + saha--Rvi Ric--kvip vA zatvam vA dIrGaH । 1 Satrujayini 2 sahanaSIle ca ।
a: अभिषाह् — a. 1 Bearing, patient. --2 Overpowering.

m: अभि-षात mfn. gained, RV. v, 41, 14.
अभि-षावक m. the priest (or any one) who expresses the Soma juice, L.
a: अभिषावकः, --षोतृ — m. The priest who extracts the Soma juice.

m: अभि-ष्णात m. pl. (√ स्ना), N. of a family, Hariv. 1466 (v.l. अभि-ग्लान and अति-ग्लान).
अभि-षू (√ 1. सू), -षुवति, to endow with (instr.), Kāṭh.; to consecrate for a purpose (acc.), ŚBr.; impf. -अषुवत्, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 63 : Desid. -सुसूषति, ib., 64 Comm.
अभि-षूद् (√ सूद्), Caus. to kill, destroy, R. i, 27, 19.

अभि-ष्ठा (√ स्था), -तिष्ठति (aor. -अस्थात्, RV., -अष्ठात्, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 63; perf. p. -तष्ठिवस्, RV. iv, 4, 9) to tread or step upon (acc.), RV.; AV.; TS.; ŚBr.; to overpower, defeat, RV.; AV.; VS.; to extend or rise over (acc.), RV. i, 149, 4 and iii, 14, 4; to step or advance towards (acc.), PBr.; Kauś.; to stay, live, MBh. xil, 3316; to stop, ib., 4475.
अभि-ष्ठित mfn. trampled upon, defeated, RV. x, 166, 2; AV.
stepped upon, serving as basis, ŚBr.
अभि-√ ष्ठिव् (perf. -तिष्ठेव, perf. Pass. p. -ष्ठ्यूत) to spit upon, ŚBr.

a: अभिषंगः — (also अभिसंगः) 1 Complete contact or union; attachment, connection, association; कन्यका दुन्वंति हृदयं मनुष्याणामीदृशाद्दुरभिसंगात् Māl. 7 ill attachment or union; Māl. 8; मुहुरिति वनविभ्रमाभिषंगात् Śi. 7. 68; K. 146, 290. --2 Defeat, mortification, discomfiture; जाताभिषंगो नृपतिः R. 2. 30. --3 A sudden blow, shock, or grief, a sudden calamity or misfortune, unexpected reverse; ततोऽभिषंगानिलविप्रविद्धा R. 14. 54, 77; Ku. 3. 73; ˚जडं विजज्ञिवान् R. 8. 75. --4 Possession by devils or evil spirits; अभिघाताभिषंगाभ्यामभिचाराभिशापतः Mādh. N. --5 An oath. --6 Embracing; copulation. --7 A curse or imprecation, abuse. --8 A false charge or accusation, calumny or defamation. --9 Contempt, disrespect. --Comp. --ज्वरः fever caused by the action of evil spirits.
अभिषंज् — {c1c} P. [˚संज्, स् being changed to ष् by P. VIII. 3. 65]. To be in contact with, touch; attach oneself to.
अभिषंजनं — = अभिषंग q. v.

m: अभि-षङ्ग m. (ifc. f(आ). , Ragh. xiv, 77) propensity or inclination to, BhP.
the state of being possessed by evil spirits (cf. भूताभिषङ्ग) or disturbed in mind, MBh.
humiliation, defeat, MBh.; Ragh.; Kum.
curse or imprecation, MBh.
false accusation, calumny, L. (cf. मिथ्याभिषङ्ग)
oath, L.
embracing, L.

k.v: कपौ च प्लवगः शापे त्वभिषङ्गः पराभवे। यानाद्यङ्गे युगः पुंसि युगं युग्मे कृतादिषु॥
कपौ च प्लवगः शापे त्वभिषङ्गः पराभवे। यानाद्यङ्गे युगः पुंसि युगं युग्मे कृतादिषु॥

m: अभि-षङ्ग—ज्वर m. a fever supposed to be caused by evil spirits.
अभि-षङ्गिन् mfn. humiliating, defeating, MBh. iv, 2108.
अभि-षण्ण mfn. besieged, oppressed, TS.; Kāṭh.
अभि-षञ्ज् (√ सञ्ज्), -षजति (Pāṇ. viii, 3, 65, Sch.) ‘to be in close contact with’, have a claim to or lay claim to, MBh. iv, 95 (v.l. अभि- √ 2. पत्); to put a slur upon (acc.), revile, curse.
1. अभि-षच् (√ सच्) Ā. -सचते to turn to, be favourable to (acc.), RV. : P. -सिषक्ति, to approach for revering, RV. vii, 67, 3.
2. अभि-षच् m. (acc. -आचम्; n. pl. -आचस्) f. n. following, accompanying, RV. vi, 63, 9; AV. xviii, 4, 44
(acc. -आचम्; n. pl. -आचस्) paying attention to, devoted to, favourable, RV.
अभि-षद् (√ सद्), -सीदति to besiege, RV. ix, 7, 5; Ved. (impf.) -अषीदत्, or -असीदत्, &c., Pāṇ. viii, 3, 119, in classical Sanskṛt only forms with ष् are allowed, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 63 and 118.

अभि-षह् (√ सह्), (perf. Subj. -सासहत् Prec. 2. sg. -सासहीष्ठास्, p. P. -साह्वस् and Ā. -सेहान) to overpower, conquer, RV.; (aor. Ā. 1. sg. -असाक्षि) to gain, win, RV. x, 159, 1; Kauś.; Nir.; to tolerate, allow, pardon, (Pass. -सह्यते), Sāh.
अभि-षह m. = निग्रह (q.v.), L.

v: tri॰ aBitaH sahyaH । 1 soQuM Sakye । lyap । 2 prasahyetyarTe avya॰ “aBizahya tu vaH kanyAM kuryyAddarpeRa mAnavaH” । manuH ।
m: अभि-षह्य ind.p. with √ 1. कृ ‘to treat by force’, commit a rape, violate (a female), Mn. viii, 367.
a: अभिषह्य — ind. By force, forcibly, violently; insolently.

m: अभि-षक्त mfn. possessed by evil spirits, L.
humiliated, defeated, L.
reviled, cursed.

klI, kAYjikaM । iti halAyuDaH ॥ kA~ji iti BAzA ।

m: अभि-षव &c. See अभि-षु.
अभि-षव m. pressing out (the juice of the Soma plant), ĀśvŚr.; KātyŚr.
distillation, L.
religious bathing, ablution (preparatory to religious rites), L.
drinking Soma juice, sacrifice, L.
ferment, yeast, any substance producing vinous fermentation, L.
consecration, Dharmaś.
अभि-षव n. sour gruel, VP.
a: अभिषव — see under अभिषु.

अभिषवः — [अभि-सु-अप्] 1 Extracting or pressing out the Soma juice. --2 Distillation or extraction (of liquors &c.). --3 Religious bathing, ablution preparatory to religious rites. --4 Bathing or ablution (in general); Ki. 3. 28. --5 Drinking the Soma juice. --6 A sacrifice in general. --7 Ferment, yeast; any substance producing fermentation. --8 A finger used in extracting Soma juice. (Nir.) --वं Sour gruel.

k.v: स्वाध्यायः स्याज्जपः सुत्याभिषवः सवनं च सा। सर्वैनसामपध्वंसि जप्यं त्रिष्वघमर्षणम्.।
सन्धानं स्यादभिषवः किण्वं पुंसि तु नग्नहूः। कारोत्तरः सुरामण्ड आपानं पानगोष्ठिका॥

a: अभिषवणी — A mechanical contrivance to press out the Soma juice.

m: अभि-षवणीस् (अभि-षवणीस्) f. pl. Ved. nom. the utensils used for pressing out (the Soma juice), AV. ix, 6, 1, 16 (cf. अधि-षवण.)
अभि-षवणीय mfn. to be expressed (as Soma juice).

m: अभि-षवण n. pressing out (the juice of the Soma plant), Nir.
bathing, Kir.
a: अभिषवणं — 1 Bathing; Ki. 6. 23. --2 Means of extracting or pressing out Soma juice.

m: अभि-षेण m. directing arrows against, RV. vi, 44, 17.
a: अभिषेण — a. Ved. Approaching (as an enemy) with an army.

m: अभि-षेणन n. marching against (in comp.) with an army, Rājat.
a: अभिषेणनं — Marching against an enemy, encountering a foe.

k.v: यत्सेनयाभिगमनमरौ तदभिषेणनम्. यात्रा व्रज्याभिनिर्वाणं प्रस्थानं गमनं गमः॥

m: अभि-षेणय Nom. P. -षेणयति, (impf. -अषेणयत्, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 63), to assail with an army, to march with an army against (acc.), Veṇīs. &c.: Desid. -षिषेणयिषति, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 64, Sch.

a: अभिषेणयति — Den. P. [अभिसेना-णिच् P. III. 1. 25, VIII. 3. 65] To march against (with an army), to attack, to face or encounter (another) with an army; कः सिंधुराजमभिषेणयितुं समर्थः Ve. 2. 25; Śi. 6. 64.

m: अभि-षेचनीय mfn. worthy of inauguration, ŚBr.
belonging to inauguration (as vessels, &c.), ŚBr. &c.
अभि-षेचनीय m. N. of a sacrificial ceremony performed at the inauguration of a king, ŚBr.; AitBr. &c.
a: अभिषेचनीय, --षेच्य, --क्य — 1 Worthy of inauguration, fit to be crowned. --2 Belonging to coronation. --यः N. of a sacrificial ceremony performed at the coronation of a king.

m: अभि-षेचन n. sprinkling, MBh.; BhP.
initiation, inauguration, R. &c.
a: अभिषेचनं — 1 Sprinkling. --2 Coronation, inauguration; R. 8. 3.

m: अभि-षेचित mfn. caused to be sprinkled, watered, wetted, Hariv.
inaugurated.
अभि-षेच्य mfn. to be anointed, R.
अभिषेकाह m. day of inauguration.
अभिषेकार्द्र-शिरस् mfn. wet on the head with the royal unction.

m: अभि-षेक m. anointing, inaugurating or consecrating (by sprinkling water), inauguration of a king, royal unction
the water or liquid used at an inauguration, ŚBr. &c.
religious bathing, ablution, MBh. &c.
bathing of the divinity to whom worship is offered, L. (cf. महाभिषेक and मूर्धाभिषेक.)
a: अभिषेकः — 1 Sprinkling, watering, wetting. --2 Anointing, inaugurating or consecrating by sprinkling water (a king, idol &c.). --3 (Particularly) Coronation, inauguration, installation (of kings); royal unction; अथाभिषेकं रघुवंशकेतोः R. 14. 7. --4 The (holy) water required at inauguration, coronation water; अमात्यपरिषदं ब्रूहि संभ्रियतामायुषो राज्याभिषेक इति V. 5; यौवराज्य˚ ibid.; R. 17. 14. --5 Bathing; ablution, holy or religious bathing; अभिषेकोत्तीर्णाय काश्यपाय Ś. 4; अत्राभिषेकाय तपोधनानां R. 13. 51, 1. 85, 10. 63, 13. 58, 14. 82; K. 22, 36, 96; Ku. 5. 16; 7. 11; Ś. 7. 12; H. 4. 87. --6 Bathing or sprinkling with water (of a divinity to whom worship is offered). --Comp. --अहः day of coronation. --शाला coronation-hall.

m: अभि-षेक-भूमि-प्रतिलम्भ m. attainment of the royal station, Sukh. i.
अभि-षेक—शाला f. the hall of coronation.
अभि-षेक्तव्य mfn. to be consecrated or anointed, Kathās.
अभि-षेक्तृ ता, m. one who consecrates (by sprinkling), VS.; ŚBr.
a: अभिषेक्तृ — a. One who sprinkles, anoints, inaugurates.

v: tri॰ aBizektumarhati aBi + sica--Ryat kutvam । aBizekayogye “aBizekyABavizyata samApluvanta ityAha rAjaputrAn” kAtyA॰ 20, 2, 17 “yUyamaSvarakzAM samApluvantaH pawwABizekayogyA BavizyaTa” karka॰ ।
m: अभिषेक्य mfn. worthy of inauguration (अभिषेक), Kauś.; KātyŚr.
(said of the elephant) used for the inauguration, Jain. (Prākṛt abhisekka).
अभि-षिध् -षेधति, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 65, Sch.: Caus. Desid. -षिषेधयिषति, ib., 64, Sch.

अभि-षिच् (√ सिच्) P., rarely Ā. (e.g. MBh. vii, 4593; Bhaṭṭ.) to sprinkle, water, wet, RV. i, 121, 6 (pr. p. -सिञ्चत्), &c.; to consecrate, anoint, appoint by consecration, AV. &c.: Ā. (Imper. 2. sg. -षिञ्चस्व, sometimes v.l. Pass. -षिच्यस्व) to consecrate one's self or have one's self consecrated, MBh.; Hariv.; R. : Ā. or Pass. to bathe, MBh. xii, 8894 and xiii, 1702 : Caus. P. to water, wet : P. (rarely Ā.) to consecrate, anoint : Ā. (with or without [Nir.] आत्मानम्) to have one's self consecrated: Desid. -षिषिक्षति and Intens. -सेसिच्यते, Pāṇ., Sch. and Comm.
a: अभिषिच् — {c6c} U. [˚सिच्, स् changed to ष् by P. VIII. 3. 65] 1 To sprinkle, pour down upon, water, wet, shower upon (fig. also); स्नातीहाभ्यषिचज्जलैः Bk. 6. 21; 15. 3; 6. 23; संगे पुनर्बहुतराममृताभिषिक्तां Ch. P. 29 v. l.; अथ वपुरभिषेक्तुं तास्तदांभोभिरीषुः Śi. 7. 75. --2 To anoint, consecrate, appoint &c. (by sprinkling water on the head); to crown, install, inaugurate (with loc. of the post of authority); अग्निवर्णमभिषिच्य राघवः स्वे पदे R. 19. 1, 17. 13; सोऽटवीराज्येऽभिषिक्तः H. 2; V. 5. 23. --Caus. 1 To have another consecrated, inaugurated &c. --2 To let oneself be crowned.

m: अभि-षिद्ध mf(आ)n. driven hither, AitBr.

v: tri॰ aBi + sica--kta । 1 kftABizeke rAjAdO “kandapaM parivIkzya nUtanamanorAjyABiziktam” sA॰ da॰ । “dIkzitezvaBiziktezu bratatIrTaparezu ca” parA॰ । “senApatyena devAnAmaBizikto guhastadA” BA॰ va॰ pa॰ 2 snAte ca । aBiziktena nirvfttam saNkalA॰ aR । ABiziktaH aBiziktanirvftte kUpe puM॰ ।
m: अभि-षिक्त mfn. sprinkled
anointed, installed, enthroned (cf. मूर्धाभिषिक्त.)
अभि-षिव् (√ सिव्) to sew round, ŚāṅkhŚr.
अभि-षिषेणयिषु See अभि-षेण.
अभि-षिषेणयिषु mfn. (fr. Desid.) desirous of marching against, Śiś. vi, 64.
अभि-षो (√ सो), (1. sg. -ष्यामि) to fetter, chain, AV. iv, 16, 9; (pr. p. -ष्यत्) to put an end to, destroy, Bhaṭṭ.; impf. -अष्यत्, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 63.
अभि-षोतृ ता, m. = अभि-षावक, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.

अभि-षु (√ 3. सु), (3. pl. -षुण्वन्ति; ind.p. -षुत्य) to press out (with stones) the Soma juice (or any other juice), ŚBr. &c.; to press out with the help of any liquid, Mn. v, 10 (Pass. 3. pl. -षूयन्ते), Suśr.; (fut. p. -सोष्यत् cf. Pāṇ. viii, 3, 117) to moisten, Bhaṭṭ. : Caus. -षावयति, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 65 Comm.
a: अभिषु — {c5c} P. (˚सु) 1 To extract Soma juice or any juice; अभिषुण्वंत आसते Ait. Br. --2 To apply water to or press out; Ms. 5. 10 (Kull. उदकेन संधा). --3 To moisten, sprinkle; Bk. 9. 90.

m: अभि-षुक m. N. of a plant, Suśr.

s: klI, (aBi + su + ktaH zatvaM .) kAYjikaM । ityamaraH ॥
v: tri॰ aBi + su--kta । 1 nizpIqite 2 kftABizave somAdO ca 3 kAYjike na॰ ।
m: अभि-षुत mfn. expressed (as Soma juice), ŚBr. &c.
अभि-षुत n. (= अभि-षव n.) sour gruel, L.
a: अभिषुत — p. p. Extracted, pressed out, as Soma juice. --तं Sour gruel.
अभिष्वंगः — [स्वंज्-घञ्] 1 Contact. --2 Intense attachment, love, affection; विद्यास्वभिष्वंगः Dk. 155; अहो अभिष्वंगः Māl. 1; काम˚ ibid. Bg. 13. 9.

m: अभि-ष्वङ्ग m. intense attachment or affection to (loc. [MBh. &c.], rarely instr. [Kathās.]).
अभि-ष्वङ्गिन् mfn. intensely attached to or mad for, MaitrUp.
अभि-ष्वञ्ज् (√ स्वञ्ज्), -ष्वजते (impf. -अष्वजत, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 63; perf. -षस्वजे, or -षस्वञ्जे, ib., 118, Kāś.) to embrace, MBh. viii, 1652 : (exceptionally) P. (Opt. -ष्वजेत्) id., MBh. xii, 8796.
अभि-ष्टूय irreg. ind.p. praising, BhP. &c.
अभि-ष्टम्भ् (√ स्तम्भ्), -ष्टभ्नोति, or -ष्टभ्नाति impf. -अष्टभ्नात्, perf. -तष्टम्भ, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 63 seqq.
अभि-ष्टन् (√ स्तन्), (Imper. 2. sg. -ष्टन) to thunder, AV. vi, 126, 2 : Caus. id., TS. : Intens. (Imper. 2. sg. -तंस्तनीहि) to roar, AV. v, 20, 1.

v: pu॰ aBi + stana ap zatvam । siMhanAde “aBizwane te adrivo yat sTA” f॰ 1, 8014, “aBizwane miMhanAde” BA॰ ।
m: अभि-ष्टन m. roaring, hollow noise, RV. i, 80, 14.
a: अभिष्टनः — [अभि-स्तन्-अप् षत्वं] Ved. Roaring, a loud shout (सिंहनाद).

m: अभि-ष्टव See अभि-ष्टु.
अभि-ष्टव m. praise, eulogy, BhP.
a: अभिष्टवः — Praise, eulogy.

v: tri॰ aBi + yaja--iza vAktin vede pf॰ ekA॰ । 1 “aBiyazwavye “mahA~ aBizwirojasA ya॰ 33, 25, aBIjyate ityaBiyazwavyaH ve॰ dI॰ । 2 aBilAze, । AsAdaBizwikfdavase yAsadugraH” ya॰ 20, 48 aBizwimaBilAzaM karotItyaBizwikft manoraTapradaH” iti vedadI॰ ।
m: अभि-ष्टि m. (स्-ति, fr. √ 1. अस् cf. 1. pl. स्-मस्, &c.) an assistant, protector [‘one who is superior or victorious’, NBD.], (generally said of Indra), RV.; VS.
(अभि-ष्टिस्), f. assistance, protection, help, RV.; AV.; VS. (cf. स्व्-अभिष्टि.)
अभि-ष्टि See s.v.
a: अभि(भी)ष्टि — a. (Ved.) To be worshipped by offering sacrifices (Sāy. अभियष्टव्य); an assistant, a protector, one who is praised or worshipped as a protector, one who approaches to assist or attack, one who assails or overpowers an enemy, one who approaches in order to obtain, desiring, desire (these meanings are given by European scholars). --ष्टिः f. Assistance, help, worshipping, praising; a sacrifice; a hymn; approaching to assist or approaching in general; access.

m: अभि-ष्टि—शवस् (अभिष्टि-), mfn. rendering powerful assistance, RV. iii, 59, 8.
अभि-ष्टि—द्युम्न (अभिष्टि-), mf(आ)n. ‘whose glory is protecting or superior’, being of benevolent majesty, RV. iv, 51, 7.
अभि-ष्टि—कृत् mfn. procuring help, assisting, RV.
अभि-ष्टि—मत् mfn. rendering assistance, RV. i, 116, 11.
a: अभिष्टिमत् — a. Ved. Desirable.

m: अभि-ष्टि—पा m(nom. -पा)fn. protecting with assistance, RV. ii, 20, 2
(the nom. -पा being irregular for -पाः, Gmn. proposes the emendation [adopted by the NBD.] अभिष्टी or अभिष्टि (Ved. instr.) पासिजनान् instead of अभिष्टिपासि जनान्).

अभि-ष्टु (√ स्तु), -ष्टौति (impf. -अष्टौत्, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 63, or also -अस्तौत्, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 119, Kāś.; Subj. 1. pl. -ष्टवाम, RV. viii, 100, 3; Imper. 2. sg. -ष्टुहि, RV. i, 54, 2) to praise, extol, RV. &c.: Ā. (3. sg.) -ष्टुवते id., MBh. xii, 7715.
a: अभिष्टु — {c2c} P. --(स्तु) 1 To praise, laud, extol; अथ इतरामभिष्टुवंति U. 5; Śi. 15. 20. --2 To consecrate, invoke; Y. 3. 307.

m: अभि-ष्टुभ् (√ स्तुभ्), -ष्टोभति (impf. -अष्टोभत्, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 63) to sing or recite in addition to, Lāṭy.

s: tri, (aBi + stu + karmmaRi ktaH .) varRitaM । stutaM । ityamaraH ॥ (“aBizwuto viSvasfjA prasUnEH” । iti BAgavatapurARe .)
v: tri॰ aBi + stu--kta । 1 varRite, 2 stute, ca ।
m: अभि-ष्टुत mfn. praised, RV.; AV. &c.
praised or addressed (with ओंकारस्), consecrated, Yājñ. iii, 307.
अभि-ष्टुवान mfn. pr. p. Ā. praising, BhP.
अभि-ष्टुवत् mfn. pr. p. P. praising, Hariv.

a: अभिष्यंद् — {c1c} A. (स् changed to ष् by P. VIII. 3. 72) 1 To ooze, flow, trickle; अभिस्यं --ष्यं --दते दुग्धं Sk.; सततमभिष्यंदमानमेघमेदुरितनीलिमा (गिरिः) U. 1 raining or pouring down water. --2 (fig.) To be melted (with pity, love &c), to overflow with; यदि त्वामीदृशं रामभद्रः पश्येत् तदास्य हृदयं स्नेहेनाभिष्यंदते U. 5.

अभिष्यं(स्यं)दः — 1 Oozing, flowing, trickling. --2 Weakness of, or running at, the eyes. --3 Great increase or enlargement, surplus, excess, superfluous portion; स्वर्गाभिष्यंदवमनं कृत्वेवोपनिवेशितं (ओषधिप्रस्थं) Ku. 6. 37 by drawing off the surplus population i. e. by emigration (अभिष्यंदः अतिरेकः अतिरिक्तजन इति यावत् तस्य वमनं निःसारणं कृत्वा स्थितमिव); cf. also R. 15. 29 Hemacandra's remarks thereon.

अभिष्यं(स्यं)दिन् — a. 1 Oozing, flowing, trickling. --2 Laxative, opening the bowels. --3 Causing defluxions or watery effusion. --Comp. --रमणं a suburb, a smaller city appended to and regarded as part of a larger one; cf. शाखानगरं.

m: अभि-ष्यन्द् (√ स्यन्द्), -स्यन्दते (or also -ष्यन्दते, if said intransitively of lifeless objects, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 72) to run towards or along (generally said of liquids), AV. v, 5, 9 (perf. -सिष्यदे, said of a plant growing or running along the stem and branches of a tree), &c.
